From a longer-term trend lens, the selloff pulls ASND below its key short- and medium-term trend gauges: it’s trading 10.3% below the 20-day SMA ($257.65) and 10% below the 50-day SMA ($256.57), which often signals that recent buyers are underwater and rallies can face supply.
The stock is also 5.9% below the 100-day SMA ($245.59) and now sits just 1.2% below the 200-day SMA ($233.92), making that longer-term line a near-term "line in the sand" for trend followers.

Momentum is best framed by MACD here: MACD is below its signal line and the histogram is negative, which points to upside pressure fading versus the prior upswing unless the stock can reclaim that baseline.

Even with that cooling momentum, the bigger-picture structure still shows the 20-day SMA above the 50-day SMA and the 50-day SMA above the 200-day SMA, so the pullback is happening inside what had been a bullish crossover stack.
